Hi there! Want to use this engine for modding? It's simple. Here's what each of the individual sprites does:


PLAYER: This is the dude on the right, or the guy you play as. You can customize the sprite costumes, and the amount of frames each animation has. 

OPPONENT: This is the dude on the left, or the guy you battle. It has the same customizing options as the player.

COLORED ARROWS: These are the arrows that are colored XD. You can customize the arrow skins.

GRAY ARROWS: These are the arrows that are gray. They have the same customizing options as the colored arrows.

DEATH: This is the player death. You can customize the skeleton and the heart.

CHART HANDLER: This is where the chart gets processed. I will release a video on my youtube channel on how to change the charts.

COMBO/HIT RATING: This is the sick/good/bad. You can't really customize this


I will release a video on my Youtube Channel on how to customize this further with things like 

SPECIAL NOTES
SPECIAL ANIMATIONS MID-SONG

and more!
